correctness.rationale: The smooth Fermat quartic over F5 has 48 explicit geometric lines over F25, three partitions times sixteen parameter choices, all exchanged in 24 nonfixed Frobenius pairs. Independent finite-field rank of each combined pair of line equations over F25 checked all 1128 intersections; Gram G has rank20, signature eigenvalues 12,-12,-8(6),-4(12),0(28), an integral twenty-line basis of discriminant -64, as supported by published complex Fermat quartic lattice. The F5 point count zero and H2 Lefschetz trace, together with Deligne Weil purity, identify the 2-dimensional Frobenius complement with roots -3±4i, whose normalized roots are not roots of unity; geometric NS rank remains20. Kummer specialization excludes all prime-to-5 overindex and the discriminant64 excludes 5-overindex. For the 24 trace divisors the HNF lattice has rank8, determinant -4096, Smith factors (2,2,2,2,2,2,8,8); independent mod2 rank8 eliminates all possible index-two invariant overlattices because 2L^Frob lies in the trace lattice. Point counts #X(F5)=0, #X(F25)=1112 agree with zeta but are not themselves the novelty claim.
